title: ‘Heated Rivalry’ Season 2 Production Is Underway as Fans Revisit the Hit Hockey Romance on Blu-ray
summary: The hit series’ soundtrack skated into the Billboard 200 top 10, while the new collector’s edition includes deleted scenes, bloopers and a NSFW poster.
contentText:

There’s a reason music feels so integral to Heated Rivalry . The series uses songs to heighten everything from the tension between its hockey stars to the quieter moments of their secret relationship. With production on season two now underway, fans can revisit the first season through the show’s DVD and Blu-ray editions .

The physical editions mark the first time viewers can own Heated Rivalry , which was previously available to stream on Crave in Canada and HBO Max in the U.S. The official release also gives fans a physical counterpart to the wide range of Heated Rivalry merchandise inspired by the series.

Shane and Ilya go shirtless on the distressed cover.

For collectors, the Season One Collector’s Edition 4K/Blu-ray comes in VHS-inspired packaging with a red “18+” sticker. The four-disc Blu-ray set includes all six episodes, along with deleted scenes, bloopers and commentary from the cast and crew. Director and co-creator Jacob Tierney and author Rachel Reid, whose Game Changers books inspired the TV series, are among those featured in the commentary.

The box also includes four collectible photo cards and a squishy hockey-puck stress reliever. There’s a double-sided poster as well, with one side featuring an image from the infamous shower scene in the first episode. It’s a fittingly cheeky extra for a series known for balancing hockey drama with a steamy romance.

The standard Blu-ray edition offers another way to own all six episodes, along with the show’s bonus features. Unlike the Collector’s Edition, it doesn’t include the collectible merch or exclusive packaging.

DVD RELEASE

'Heated Rivalry: Season One' (DVD)

Go behind the scenes with bonus content including deleted scenes and a blooper reel.

With the second season of Heated Rivalry expected in spring 2027, fans have some time to catch up on the first season or revisit their favorite moments. The standard DVD includes all six episodes, plus bonus features from the series.

The series stars Connor Storrie and Hudson Williams as hockey rivals Ilya Rozanov and Shane Hollander, whose secret relationship unfolds alongside their careers on the ice. Based on Reid’s Game Changers book series, Heated Rivalry premiered on Crave and HBO Max in November 2025 and quickly became a breakout hit.

That success extended to the music charts . The Heated Rivalry soundtrack debuted at No. 8 on the Billboard 200 with 41,000 equivalent album units, all from album sales, according to Luminate. It became the first TV series soundtrack in more than a decade to debut in the top 10 and also topped the Soundtracks, Vinyl Albums and Indie Store Album Sales charts. Its vinyl editions sold a combined 28,000 copies in the opening week, marking the biggest vinyl sales week for a soundtrack in 2026.
